highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP.
highlights_body: It reworks the singleton lifecycle, adds variable font and color-font-palette support, animated WebP encoding, and zero-copy stream-to-data conversion. This is a breaking release with several behavioral changes from the Skia m132 engine jump — check the changes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo
breaking.body: The property changed type from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost IEquatable/operator== support. Update field access and replace equality comparisons that relied on Equals/== on GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose no longer has a public setter
breaking.body: The property is now get-only. Remove any direct assignment to IgnorePublicDispose from derived types.

breaking.title: new SKFont() and new SKPaint() no longer default to a null Typeface
breaking.body: SKFont's typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty instead of null (so MeasureText returns 0 until you set one), and SKPaint's is SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Replace `Typeface == null` checks with `Typeface.IsEmpty`, and pass an explicit typeface to SKFont when you need text metrics.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and SKTypeface.Default are now never null
breaking.body: A missing family (including on Android) now resolves to SKTypeface.Default instead of null, and SKTypeface.Default itself is guaranteed non-null on every platform. For a strict "was it found?" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily, which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete
breaking.body: The previously silent truncating cast to int is now a checked cast that throws OverflowException for out-of-range offsets, and the overload is marked [Obsolete]. Call Move(int) with an in-range, pre-validated offset instead.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on a Vulkan 1.0 instance
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1; a sub-1.1 instance or an unset GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion causes a fatal native abort instead of CreateVulkan returning null. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance's apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion, and fall back to raster on genuinely 1.0-only hardware.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures; the rest have no replacement.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled Skia engine from m132 through m148, folding in several rounds of upstream Chrome bug fixes merged across the preview cycle.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, plus color font palette support and improved variable font robustness.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream data
bullets.detail: Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP encoding, and SKStream.GetData() for converting a stream to SKData without copying.

bullets.lead: New API wrappers and HBColor struct
bullets.detail: Adds a proper HBColor struct for hb_color_t, adds SKSamplingOptions support to SKSurface.Draw/SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and fills in missing API wrappers while fixing naming-convention violations.
Reworks how singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compat gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup.
GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the correct axis for offsets on both SKPixmap and SKBitmap, and a finalizer crash is fixed when an SKPathBuilder is collected before its SKPath.
Moves default-typeface resolution to the managed layer, and fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers.
Adds Linux Bionic native assets, x64/arm64 Tizen native builds, and PolySharp-based C# 13 support on legacy target frameworks; also fixes SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch.
Updates expat to 2.8.1, harfbuzz to 14.2.0, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1, libpng to 1.6.58, and libexpat to 2.7.5.

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Opened the v4 line by bumping Skia to milestone 132/147 and adding variable font and color-font-palette support.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Added animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), and fixed the SKPath finalizer crash.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Landed native dependency refreshes (harfbuzz, expat, freetype, zlib), the HBColor struct, and warnings-as-errors cleanup in binding/.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Bumped Skia to milestone 148, reworked the singleton lifecycle, and fixed pixel-span stride/offset bugs ahead of the stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds variable-font shaping support and the new HBColor value type, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.
